thread:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: service=infra-night (id: svc_7Yh2), incident=INC-12873, urgency=high. Trigger: 5xx-rate > 5% for 5m. Routed to schedule infra-night.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty notification: routed to team 'platform-oncall' (schedule id: sched_9Xq1). Pager link: https://pd.example/INC-12873

marta: wait — why did platform-oncall get this? infra-night should own that service.

kai: i got the push. i was halfway through a handoff but this is definitely infra alerts usually.

alex: can someone confirm any customer impact? metrics dashboard shows spike in 502s for inference gateway in us-west-2. looks like a small subset of requests.

marta: CS pinged about errors in model-serving for a few enterprise customers. they're seeing 502s and retries.

samir: logging into PD now. i see the escalation path shows a binding to platform-oncall because of a legacy tag on the alert rule.

marta: ugh — we've seen this before. ops-rotation-bot, did we recently rename schedules?

ops-rotation-bot: Schedule rename detected 4d ago: 'infra-night' -> 'infra-night-legacy' (admin: @ops-admin). Some services still reference old schedule id sched_4A2b.

kai: ok that explains routing. PD rule for svc_7Yh2 points to schedule id sched_4A2b which is currently bound to platform-oncall via a legacy team mapping.

marta: mitigation plan: 1) acknowledge and silence the noisy PD alerts to stop fanout. 2) rebind the service to the infra-night schedule id sched_9Xq1 (the correct one). 3) short oncall handover to infra to investigate root cause of 502s.

pagerduty-bot: Acknowledgement recorded: incident=INC-12873 ack_by=kai at 3945680000

kai: i've acknowledged. applying temporary maintenance window on svc_7Yh2 to suppress repeated pages for 30m.

samir: i'm creating a PD override now to rebind service -> correct schedule. snippet:```json
{"service_id":"svc_7Yh2","old_schedule":"sched_4A2b","new_schedule":"sched_9Xq1","author":"samir","reason":"routing mismatch, emergency rebind"}
```

samir: override applied, rebind complete. PagerDuty now shows routed to infra-night.

marta: can infra take primary? @kai handing over to @alex for on-call investigation. alex, you good?

alex: taking it. i've spun up a query on the gateway logs. early signal: increased 502s correlate with a new model shard rollout around 02:12 UTC. hitting a subset of GPUs in us-west-2.

kai: remind me — did Optimize caching changes go out in that rollout?

alex: yes, a canary quantization batch was rolled at 02:10. i'm rolling that canary back for affected hosts.

marta: customer impact: we've notified the three affected enterprise customers via CS. severity: degraded but partial (retryable errors).

samir: PD routing fix confirmed, oncall ownership transferred, maintenance window set. i recommend a follow-up configuration cleanup: remove legacy schedule alias sched_4A2b from all service bindings.

ops-rotation-bot: Action items created: #A1 remove legacy schedule alias from PD service configs, #A2 postmortem to include routing drift + rollout rollback timeline, #A3 add a monitor to detect schedule id mismatches.

kai: quick note — can we add a guard in CI that prevents renaming schedules without cross-updating service bindings? low effort but would prevent this.

marta: agreed. i'll file the RFC. for now, alex please confirm when 502 rate is back under threshold.

alex: rollback in progress. preliminary numbers: 502 rate down 60% in the last 3 minutes. will update when back to normal.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-12873 status: acknowledged -> resolved by alex at 3945680402. resolution: routing corrected + canary rollback.

marta: nice work. postmortem owners: samir (routing cleanup), alex (rollback/investigation), kai (CI guard). i'll draft interim incident note and tag CS/Support.

samir: adding a quick checklist to prevent repeats: 1) audit PD service bindings weekly, 2) add schedule-id lint in deployment pipelines, 3) add PD binding unit tests.

alex: confirmed 502s back to baseline. marking incident resolved on our side.

marta: closing thread — follow-up postmortem due EOD tomorrow. thanks all. :heart:
